presentation.label: The club
presentation.title: Science DUCA
presentation.text: Science DUCA welcomes you in a professional training facility in the heart of Marseille. Founded over 10 years ago, our team trains athletes of all levels in MMA disciplines: boxing, kickboxing, grappling and wrestling. Whether you want to learn self-defense, prepare for competition or simply improve your fitness — you're in the right place.

method.label: The method
method.title: Our method
method.text1: Our strength & conditioning programs are designed for MMA practitioners — beginners and competitors alike. Every plan is structured week by week, with coach follow-up, explainer videos and an adapted nutrition protocol.
method.text2: No generic copy-paste programs. Each plan matches a specific profile and concrete goals.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do I need to already practice MMA?
faq.a1: No. The Foundations program is specifically designed for beginners or people returning after a break. There are no technical prerequisites.
faq.q2: How does the coach follow-up work?
faq.a2: Depending on the program, follow-up is done via a private group (messages and questions) or with personalized weekly feedback. Everything is done remotely, online.
faq.a3: Programs run between 8 and 16 weeks depending on the level. Each week is planned with detailed sessions, explainer videos and clear objectives.
faq.q4: Can I combine it with my MMA membership?
faq.a4: Yes, it's even recommended. The conditioning programs are designed to be compatible with 2 to 4 MMA training sessions per week.
